scope: Verified unpublished-session abort and exact-owner LOGOFF retirement; complete G0/full-feature gates remain open
implemented: After a verified initial/auxiliary final response, authenticator disposal failure attempts one ordinary Session.close/LOGOFF under that session's verified keys and native MID reservation.

Conditional session-table registration supplies verified cleanup response state; identity removal occurs after cleanup. Active identity conflicts are preserved, cleanup failures are suppressed only when distinct, and the original disposal failure is returned.

Session.LOGOFF retains its exact selected connection and original session-configured timeout. Failed waits retire MID/cancel lookup state and settle the abandoned promise before session key removal. Connection authentication/LOGOFF waits reuse abandonment; ordinary timeout tracking is retained.

Real Kerberos fixture injects IOException after actual GSS disposal, confirms one abort LOGOFF, holds another real success reply past the wait deadline, verifies tracking retirement and harmless late plain delivery, continues older/main I/O and retries binding on the same borrowed candidate.
